C1421.title: SandWatch Ethereum Sandwich Attack Detection Study
C1421.summary: The 2026 SandWatch study proposed a dual-task graph neural network that identifies both Ethereum sandwich-attack transactions and attacker accounts. The authors detected 563,453 sandwich attacks, including 24,404 multi-attacks, 4,902 cross-block attacks, and 1,057 pool-failure variants, and reported an overall recall of 98.63 percent.

references.title: SandWatch: Detecting Ethereum Sandwich Attacks Using a Dual-Task Graph Neural Network
